recalled_knowledge.item: Rutherford cross-section dsigma/dq^2 = 4 pi Z^2 eps^2 alpha^2/(v^2 q^4) and its E_R form
LZ TPC 1.456 m diameter x 1.456 m drift length
SURF depth 1478 m, standard rock 2.7 g/cm^3, crustal composition O/Si/Al/Fe/Ca/K/Na/Mg mass fractions
Thomas-Fermi screening length a = 0.885 a0 Z^-1/3
Lindhard-Scharff electronic stopping S_e = 8 pi e^2 a0 Z1^(7/6) Z2/(Z1^(2/3)+Z2^(2/3))^(3/2) v/v0; eps^2 scaling for a fractional point charge
Minimum-ionising dE/dx in xenon ~1.25 MeV cm^2/g
Nuclearite cross-section pi (1e-8 cm)^2 for M < 1.5 ng; dE/dx = sigma rho v^2
Slow monopole effective charge g beta = beta/(2 alpha) e and Ahlen-Kinoshita-type dE/dx ~ (g/e)^2 K (Z/A) rho beta L
Parker bound 1e-15 cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1; MACRO monopole flux limit 1.4e-16
Feldman-Cousins 90 % upper limit for n = 1, b = 0 is 4.36
Heliospheric magnetic field ~5 nT at 1 AU; Earth's field ~3e-5 T; millicharged evacuation by solar-wind fields
LZ 2024 SI limit ~1e-47 cm^2 at TeV masses
Heavy-DM / SIMP exclusion regions: XENON1T/LZ single-scatter, CDMS-I/XQC, CRESST and EDELWEISS surface runs, Majorana Demonstrator, DEAP-3600 multiscatter, MICA, rocky-planet heat

failed_or_abandoned: First script run failed because output/work/P080 did not exist before the shell redirect; directory created and re-run.
Fig. 2 initially clipped the upper branch of the N=1 loop at the sigma-grid ceiling 1e-22 cm^2 and had overlapping annotations; grid extended to 1e-19 and layout fixed.

A 'SIMP window' in which the overburden filters the velocity distribution towards high recoil energies: for m > 1e4 GeV the rock is transparent at sigma(lambda = 97 cm), for m < 1e3 GeV particles are thermalised; no regime enhances 248 keV relative to 5.4-55 keV.
The assignment's '5.5 t, 1.3 m x 1.3 m' fiducial replaced by the paper's 4.71 t with the stated z cuts (1.29 m x 1.24 m).
